youtube_description:
Embark on an epic free to play sci-fi adventure with Spacelords! Fight your way through four thrilling cooperative campaigns and liberate the fabled Broken Planet from the invading factions. But beware of the Antagonists: players who have thrown their lot in with the enemy and whose sole objective is to foul your progress. Recruit from among the most dangerous outlaws, rogues and renegades the galaxy has to offer customizing one of 17 Raiders to your own play style. With over 70 weapons and 500 Character Cards to choose from, YOU decide who will be the ultimate Spacelord!
